market_view: Tech-led risk-off continues with QQQ -1.92% and XLK -3.2% while VIX spikes to 16.66 (+8.18%) — defensive rotation into XLV, XLP, and XLF is holding, and that same haven bid is supporting GLD structurally. GLD at 400.27 still has 2.57% cushion above the 390 short strike.

GLD 390/385p.reasoning: Mid cost at $1.50 is now 61% of credit received ($0.93), which exceeds the 1.5x stop trigger ($1.395) on a mid basis — however GLD continues to benefit from the equity risk-off haven bid and is still 2.57% above the 390 short strike with 41 DTE. The deterioration is meaningful but not blowing through, and closing now locks in a $57 loss when the structural tailwind (equity weakness driving gold demand) is actively working in the position's favor.
